newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to raise Feb wholesale product prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to raise Feb wholesale product prices.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd, a leading Japanese refiner, said on Tuesday it would raise the wholesale price of its oil products by 1,200 yen per kilolitre (kl) effective from February 1.
The rise reflects higher market prices of December-loading crudes compared to the previous month, and a weaker yen, Nippon Oil said in a statement.
Following the hike, gasoline will be priced at 92,400 yen and gas oil at 70,700 yen per kl, both including tax.
Kerosene, which is not taxed at the wholesale stage will be 38,600 yen per kl, Nippon Oil said.
Major Japanese oil companies review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international prices of crude and oil products as well as moves on the currency market.
